description: FREE, no payment: convert a latitude and longitude to a military grid reference (MGRS, 1 m precision, WGS84), or an MGRS reference back to latitude and longitude. Send lat and lon, or mgrs. Computed by an algorithm, no data. Works from 80 S to 84 N. Check a result against a map before you rely on it to find or reach a place.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Give lat and lon together, or mgrs.

mgrs.description: An MGRS reference, for example 15T WG 00000 49776. Spaces and case do not matter.

name: convert_mgrs
